n9f51535bc0.headline: Court Lets Sh5tn National Infrastructure Fund Proceed Under Judicial Oversight
n9f51535bc0.summary: A Kenyan court allowed the Sh5tn National Infrastructure Fund to proceed under judicial oversight. The court directed the National Treasury to disclose the dates money is deposited into accounts at the Central Bank of Kenya.
n9f51535bc0.why: National infrastructure funds finance large public works and their legal status affects government spending and investor confidence in Kenya's public finances.

n83fd83a6bb.headline: High Court Nullifies Ruto’s Public Debt Audit Task Force as Unconstitutional
n83fd83a6bb.summary: The High Court ruled that President Ruto exceeded his constitutional authority by creating a public debt audit task force. The court found its functions duplicated those of an independent constitutional office.
n83fd83a6bb.why: Public debt oversight shapes investor confidence in Kenya's sovereign finances and its relations with creditors and international lenders.

ncb9f4b1659.headline: Dubai offers £600 rewards to residents who lure friends to visit as tourist numbers plummet - AOL
ncb9f4b1659.summary: Dubai is offering dining and hotel packages to residents who persuade friends and family to visit. The city's tourist numbers have fallen sharply amid the Iran war.
ncb9f4b1659.why: Dubai is a major global tourism and aviation hub, so falling visitor numbers affect hotels, airlines and retail across the United Arab Emirates economy.

n60594f3cc7.headline: Chithyola Banda: K100bn FDH Bank loan may breach public finance law | Nyasa Times
n60594f3cc7.summary: Malawi's Leader of the Opposition alleges the government secretly borrowed K100 billion from a commercial lender, claiming the loan may breach public finance law.
n60594f3cc7.why: Government borrowing from commercial banks affects public debt levels, fiscal credibility and the outlook for Malawi's sovereign financing.

source.name: Malawi News | Breaking News, Politics, Business & Sports | Nyasa Times

sources.name: Malawi News | Breaking News, Politics, Business & Sports | Nyasa Times

n5b81c94189.headline: No decision yet to raise ethanol blending in petrol beyond 20 per cent: Govt
n5b81c94189.summary: The Indian government told Parliament that no decision has been taken to increase ethanol blending in petrol beyond 20%. The statement came in the Parliament session.
n5b81c94189.why: Ethanol blending policy affects fuel demand, agricultural feedstock use and India's crude oil import needs.

nf373954ee8.headline: Hormuz blockade drives Gulf states to fast-track oil pipelines
nf373954ee8.summary: Gulf states are investing billions in new oil pipelines to bypass the Strait of Hormuz. The Iran war has disrupted shipping and fuelled price rises.
nf373954ee8.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne Gulf oil exports, so disruption there raises energy prices and shipping risk.
nf373954ee8.why_moved: The Iran war has disrupted shipping through Hormuz and fuelled price rises, according to the report.

n8467b4f428.headline: Mobileye CEO Amnon Shashua to step aside as company pushes into robotaxis, robotics
n8467b4f428.summary: Mobileye CEO Amnon Shashua is stepping aside as the company expands into robotaxis and robotics, and he has been invited to become board chairman.
n8467b4f428.why: Mobileye is an autonomous driving technology supplier, and leadership changes can signal shifts in strategy.

n99c1cc6666.headline: US military says it’s carrying out strikes on Iran as both sides threaten civilian infrastructure - The Boston Globe
n99c1cc6666.summary: The US military said it is carrying out strikes on Iran as both sides threaten civilian infrastructure, with the US president's latest threat coming as the war spirals with no clear off-ramp.
n99c1cc6666.why: Threats to infrastructure and an open-ended conflict raise risks to regional energy supply and global oil prices.
n99c1cc6666.why_moved: Threats to civilian infrastructure and no clear end to the conflict raise risks to regional energy supply, which tends to lift oil prices.

n04ab0fbd3d.headline: Motilal Oswal Financial Services Q1 Net Profit ₹1,273.11 Crore, Revenue Up 28% Year-On-Year
n04ab0fbd3d.summary: Motilal Oswal Financial Services reported a consolidated net profit of ₹1,273.11 crore for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, up 10% year on year. Revenue from operations rose 28% to ₹3,425.76 crore.
n04ab0fbd3d.why: Motilal Oswal is an Indian brokerage and financial services group, and its results reflect activity in India's equity and capital markets.

nb2f57c7db5.headline: Who is Ashiss Kumar Dash? Meet the Infosys CEO Designate who will take over from Salil Parekh in April 2027 - BusinessToday
nb2f57c7db5.summary: Ashiss Kumar Dash, a three-decade Infosys veteran who heads a diversified business portfolio, has been named CEO designate. He will take over from Salil Parekh in April 2027.
nb2f57c7db5.why: Infosys is one of India's largest IT services exporters, so leadership succession affects strategy and investor confidence in its digital services business.

nea796c5b02.headline: Surprise jobs jump gives RBA room to raise rates
nea796c5b02.summary: A larger-than-expected rise in Australian employment will not ease Reserve Bank inflation concerns, which are being fed by rising oil prices. The report adds to the case for tighter policy.
nea796c5b02.why: Employment data feeds into Reserve Bank decisions on the cash rate, which affects bond yields and the Australian dollar.

n9b9d646fdd.headline: Higher rates and pricey petrol as economic outlook dims
n9b9d646fdd.summary: Australian bond traders are fully pricing in another Reserve Bank rate hike by the end of the year. Rising petrol prices are weighing on the economic outlook.
n9b9d646fdd.why: Rate expectations set by the Reserve Bank drive Australian government bond yields and the currency.

n5a2e764256.headline: US-Iran War Stalemate: Hardliners vs Peace Party
n5a2e764256.summary: US and Iran are trading air strikes and missile attacks. A ground invasion looks costlier, and both sides are drifting toward attrition, according to the report.
n5a2e764256.why: Iran's oil exports and Gulf shipping routes are central to global energy supply, so prolonged conflict raises risks for energy markets and regional stability.

n548e5c43d3.headline: Wall Street Plunges as Oil Tops $100
n548e5c43d3.summary: US stocks slumped amid soaring oil prices, Middle East tensions and weak earnings from Alphabet and Tesla. Oil has climbed above $100 a barrel.
n548e5c43d3.why: The S&P 500 tracks large US companies, and oil price spikes feed into inflation, consumer costs and corporate margins.

n95c8337764.headline: OPEC+ Set to Raise Output Again—Even as Members Can
n95c8337764.summary: OPEC+ is expected to approve another production target increase when eight key producers meet on August 2. The move extends a months-long campaign to unwind voluntary supply cuts.
n95c8337764.why: OPEC+ sets production policy for a large share of global crude supply, so its output decisions directly influence oil prices.

n53b38d0646.headline: From Haldiram’s to Lakshmi Mittal: Who made millions from Skyroot, India’s first private space unicorn - BusinessToday
n53b38d0646.summary: Skyroot Aerospace launched Vikram-1, India's first privately developed orbital rocket, from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota. The launch made Skyroot India's first private space unicorn.
n53b38d0646.why: Skyroot is a private Indian space company, and its success signals growing commercial participation in India's space sector.

n3cb6c5b6be.headline: Trump Plans To Use Iranian Funds For Ship Damage Costs
n3cb6c5b6be.summary: President Trump announced the US will use Iranian funds to cover ship damages from Iranian strikes. The frozen assets were part of a defunct cease-fire, and the move may face legal challenges amid US-Iran negotiations.
n3cb6c5b6be.why: Frozen state assets and sanctions-related funds can affect legal disputes, shipping costs and diplomatic talks between the US and Iran. Such moves can influence energy and shipping risk premiums.

n05137975bf.headline: Houthis claim attacks on Saudi tankers, raising Red Sea chokepoint risk
n05137975bf.summary: The Houthis claimed attacks on Saudi tankers, raising risk at the Red Sea chokepoint. Analysts see the move as a tactical step by Iran to gain leverage in any diplomatic efforts to end the war.
n05137975bf.why: The Red Sea and Bab el-Mandeb strait carry a large share of global oil and container traffic. Attacks there raise shipping costs and crude prices.
n05137975bf.why_moved: Claimed attacks on Saudi tankers raise the perceived risk to oil flows through the Red Sea chokepoint.

nd5ce29309d.headline: Global power demand to accelerate in 2026 and 2027, IEA says
nd5ce29309d.summary: The International Energy Agency expects global electricity demand to grow 3.6% in 2026 and 3.8% in 2027, up from 3% in 2025. Renewables are expected to become the world's largest source of power generation in 2026.
nd5ce29309d.why: The IEA is the Paris-based energy agency advising major economies, and its demand forecasts shape investment in power generation, grids and energy equipment.

n9d1edc6e9a.headline: Pakistan seeks USD 10bn from US after Iran mediation role: Report
n9d1edc6e9a.summary: Pakistan has sought a $10 billion US stabilisation facility after its role in Iran mediation, Reuters reported, citing a source. The report has not been confirmed in the input.
n9d1edc6e9a.why: External financing support from large economies affects Pakistan's foreign reserves, currency stability and ability to service its debt.

ne339983ddd.headline: STARTRADER Launches SKHY as SK Hynix Makes Its US Market Debut, Giving Clients Timely Access to a Key AI Memory Name
ne339983ddd.summary: SK Hynix made its US market debut, and STARTRADER launched an SKHY product giving clients exposure to the high-bandwidth memory supplier. The input is a press release.
ne339983ddd.why: SK Hynix is a leading supplier of high-bandwidth memory chips used in AI accelerators, making its market access relevant to semiconductor investors.

impacts.name: SK Hynix
impacts.why: The US market debut gives the company a new listing venue and wider investor access.

n8111e6c08b.headline: Trump Warns Iran Over Houthi Attacks On Saudi Ships In Red Sea
n8111e6c08b.summary: President Trump said Iran will be held responsible for future Houthi attacks on ships after the rebels struck two Saudi tankers. Shipping disruptions have sent oil prices soaring, the input says.
n8111e6c08b.why: The Red Sea is a major shipping route for oil and goods, so attacks on tankers affect crude prices, freight costs and insurance rates.
n8111e6c08b.why_moved: Houthi strikes on two Saudi tankers and ongoing shipping disruption have pushed oil prices sharply higher, according to the input.

n7cb6ceab85.headline: Trump imposes double-digit tariffs on dozens of countries as his 10% levies are set to expire Friday
n7cb6ceab85.summary: President Donald Trump is going ahead with new double-digit tariffs on dozens of U.S. trading partners. The move comes as his 10% levies are set to expire Friday.
n7cb6ceab85.why: US tariffs change the cost of imports and exports across many economies, affecting trade flows, corporate margins and currency and bond markets.
n7cb6ceab85.why_moved: New double-digit tariffs on dozens of trading partners raise trade-policy uncertainty as earlier 10% levies expire.

nee90f64a3a.headline: Will SpaceX buy Tesla? Elon Musk is not revealing his plans
nee90f64a3a.summary: Wall Street is discussing a possible Tesla-SpaceX merger reported to be worth $3 trillion. Elon Musk has not revealed his plans, according to the report.
nee90f64a3a.why: Tesla is a leading electric-vehicle maker and SpaceX is a private space company; any combination would be a major corporate transaction.

n84915ff87f.headline: US Treasury finds no trading partner manipulated currency for trade advantage in 2025
n84915ff87f.summary: The US Treasury found no trading partner manipulated its currency for trade advantage in 2025. Ten economies, including Singapore, remain on a list for enhanced monitoring of their foreign exchange practices.
n84915ff87f.why: The Treasury's currency report assesses major trading partners for manipulation and sets monitoring lists that can shape trade-policy pressure on currencies. It matters for FX and trade-exposed markets.

n7bf4e3f9aa.headline: Trump to impose double-digit tariffs on dozens of countries
n7bf4e3f9aa.summary: The United States will impose tariffs of 10% to 12.5% on imports from 60 countries, which account for 99% of US imports. The measure cites inadequate enforcement of bans on forced-labor goods.
n7bf4e3f9aa.why: Broad US tariffs raise import costs for American businesses and consumers and can trigger retaliation. Trade policy is a major driver of global equity and currency markets.
n7bf4e3f9aa.why_moved: The tariffs cover imports from countries accounting for 99% of US imports, which raises trade-policy uncertainty and import costs.

nc461067d53.headline: S&P Upgrade Lifts Pakistan Sovereign Rating to B
nc461067d53.summary: S&P raised Pakistan's long-term sovereign rating from B-minus to B with a stable outlook. Analysts warn the upgrade is not yet proof of broad economic recovery.
nc461067d53.why: Sovereign credit ratings influence the borrowing costs a country pays on international bonds. Upgrades can reduce perceived default risk for investors.

n9af8ed838c.headline: Brent oil tops $100 per barrel, as tumbles for Tesla and Alphabet yank Wall Street lower
n9af8ed838c.summary: Brent crude rose to its highest price since May after increased fighting in the Middle East threatened to slow the global flow of crude. Tech stock declines weighed on Wall Street.
n9af8ed838c.why: Brent is the main global benchmark for crude oil, and supply disruptions in the Middle East feed directly into fuel, transport and inflation costs.
n9af8ed838c.why_moved: Increased fighting in the Middle East threatened to slow the global flow of crude, lifting Brent to its highest level since May.

n117169fe65.headline: Samsung Electro-Mechanics books W750b in AI server orders
n117169fe65.summary: Samsung Electro-Mechanics signed a supply contract worth about 300 billion won ($204 million) for multilayer ceramic capacitors used in AI servers.
n117169fe65.why: Samsung Electro-Mechanics makes passive components used in electronics, including AI server hardware. Large contracts signal demand for AI infrastructure components.

nc1d2bdf6e7.headline: Westports records higher net profit of RM360.9mil in 2Q, div of 14.98c/share
nc1d2bdf6e7.summary: Westports Holdings reported higher second-quarter net profit of RM360.9mil and a dividend of 14.98 sen per share. It expects container throughput roughly flat year on year.
nc1d2bdf6e7.why: Westports is a major Malaysian container port operator, and its throughput reflects regional trade volumes. Its dividend and profit trends matter to income-focused investors.

n7fee0143db.headline: Thailand Secures $43.6bn 1H 2026 Investment Surge as Big Tech Accelerates Southeast Asia AI Infrastructure Push
n7fee0143db.summary: Thailand secured $43.6 billion in foreign and domestic investment in the first half of 2026 as Big Tech accelerates its AI infrastructure push in Southeast Asia.
n7fee0143db.why: Foreign direct investment flows into data centres and digital infrastructure shape Thailand's growth outlook and its standing as a regional technology hub.

n24d05a3cf4.headline: BCDA: 0ver 30 firms interested in Pax Silica project
n24d05a3cf4.summary: About 30 companies have expressed interest in investing in Pax Silica, a US-led project in New Clark City expected to generate up to P75 billion in annual tax revenue and 190,000 jobs.
n24d05a3cf4.why: Semiconductor and supply-chain investment projects can shift industrial capacity and tax revenue, drawing foreign capital into host economies.

n92e555a7a8.headline: Maybank, CGIF ink MOU to strengthen Asean+3 local currency capital markets
n92e555a7a8.summary: Maybank and Credit Guarantee and Investment Facility signed a memorandum of understanding to strengthen and deepen local currency capital markets across ASEAN+3, including China, Japan and South Korea.
n92e555a7a8.why: Maybank is one of Southeast Asia's largest banks, and local currency bond markets reduce reliance on foreign-currency borrowing in the region.

nab24ef64c3.headline: Pag-IBIG housing loans surge to P69.2 billion
nab24ef64c3.summary: Housing loan releases by the Pag-IBIG Fund climbed 15% to P69.19 billion in the first half from P60.25 billion a year earlier. The growth was driven by socialized housing under the Expanded 4PH program.
nab24ef64c3.why: The Pag-IBIG Fund is the Philippines' state-run mutual savings and housing finance fund, so its lending volumes indicate the health of residential credit and construction demand.

n2ce89336b4.headline: Budget gap widens to P786.8 billion in H1
n2ce89336b4.summary: The Philippines booked a first-half budget deficit of P786.8 billion, 2.8% wider than a year earlier. The gap remained below the programmed level as revenue growth outpaced spending, Treasury data showed.
n2ce89336b4.why: The budget deficit indicates how much the government borrows to fund spending, which shapes sovereign debt issuance and bond yields.

ne3eb592ad2.headline: Japan Funds Silicon Spin Qubit Development Using Intel's 18A Chip Process
ne3eb592ad2.summary: Hitachi, Intel K.K. and AIST launched a NEDO-funded project to build silicon spin qubit chips on Intel's 18A process. The project targets a 100-qubit prototype by fiscal 2028 and a 1,000-qubit platform later.
ne3eb592ad2.why: Intel's foundry business manufactures advanced chips for third parties, and quantum computing is an emerging area of semiconductor and computing investment.

impacts.name: Intel
impacts.why: Intel's 18A process is the manufacturing technology used for the quantum chip project.

nb12c39ca10.headline: Shares rebound on bargain hunting
nb12c39ca10.summary: Investors turned to bargain hunting, lifting the local stock market after a two-day decline. The report did not give index levels or volume figures.
nb12c39ca10.why: The Philippine Stock Exchange index tracks the country's largest listed companies and is a benchmark for local equity sentiment.

nd42ad53cb9.headline: Over 500 jobs saved as UK restaurant chain escapes administration
nd42ad53cb9.summary: A UK restaurant chain avoided administration, preserving more than 500 jobs.
nd42ad53cb9.why: Avoiding administration preserves employment and business continuity in the UK hospitality sector, important for economic recovery.
